messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> svc-infer is seeing a sudden spike in 5xx and abnormal token sequences. Alert tags: kv-cache, continuous-batching. Paging alice.sre, dave.oncall, bob.runtime.
alice.sre: on call, starting triage. Can someone paste customer impact and recent deploys?
dave.oncall: grabbing oncall now. Handing over in ~2m. bob.runtime, what was the last rollout id and any config flips today?
bob.runtime: canary rollout earlier today (deploy 2026-03-15T01:12Z). We also enabled continuous_batch.window_growth in the runtime config ~1h ago. Alerts started ~2149999100.
carol.ml: FYI we merged a reuse micro-optimization last week that reuses KV segments by convo-key + seq-offset. If the seq-offset check is wrong it can return stale segments for new requests.
alice.sre: timeline so far: config flip -> ten minutes -> errors. Traces show outputs containing fragments from earlier unrelated requests (cross-request leakage).
eve.cs: CS reports 3 customers with corrupted outputs and a few aborted streams. Customer-X saw a previous turn prefixed to new responses.
bob.runtime: logs snippet: 
```
[svc-infer] WARN  kv_cache: reuse_hit conv=conv:6789 seq_offset=58 last_seen=2149999054
[svc-infer] ERROR gen: seq_mismatch expected=59 got=13 req=abc123
[svc-infer] INFO  batching: continuous_batch.window=8 inflight=12
```
This points to reuse returning entries with wrong seq_offset.
alice.sre: That matches the symptoms: bad seq offsets -> generation errors -> 5xxs. Also seen: KV metadata growth on hosts, likely because reuse prevents normal eviction.
dave.oncall: Low-risk mitigations? We need something reversible without a full deploy.
bob.runtime: Two quick mitigations: 1) flip runtime flag kv.reuse=false to stop reuse immediately. 2) set continuous_batch.window_growth=disabled or max_window=1 to reduce accumulation. Both are config-only and revertable.
alice.sre: Let's flip kv.reuse first and monitor. dave, can you apply and run a smoke?
dave.oncall: POST /ops/configs/svc-infer {"kv.reuse":"false"} -> 200 OK. Applying canary -> 100%. Change id cfg-2149999155.
deploy-bot: config change applied to svc-infer (cfg-2149999155) by dave.oncall.
bob.runtime: after flip: 5xxs dropped from ~8% to ~1.5% within 3 minutes. Latency for affected routes improved.
carol.ml: Good stopgap. We should still purge keys that are likely poisoned because reuse=false stops new reuse but existing faulty entries persist until TTL.
infra-john: Running a safe purge preview: criteria last_seen < 2149999050 AND seq_offset_delta > 10. Preview shows ~520 keys on one shard. I'll stage evictions across shards with a small cadence.
dave.oncall: Start staged eviction, 20s per shard, monitoring.
alice.sre: After first shard eviction we saw error rate dip further to 0.4%. Memory metrics also trended down.
eve.cs: Messaging CS: "We've disabled cache reuse and are purging affected entries. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and timeline for a full fix." CS acknowledged.
bob.runtime: Root cause hypothesis: under certain timing, seq_offset arithmetic underflows/overlaps if a request finishes while another with same convo-key starts, leading reuse lookup to return the wrong segment. Combined with window_growth allowed many segments to live, amplifying impact.
carol.ml: Reproducer is reliable in local tests: two concurrent requests with identical convo-key and interleaved token flush cause reused segment with stale offset to be picked.
alice.sre: Next actions: keep kv.reuse=false in prod, push a correctness patch that enforces strict seq checks and never reuses if offsets mismatch, add monitoring for reuse_hit_seq_mismatch, and add a circuit-breaker to continuous_batch.window_growth.
bob.runtime: I'll prepare a small patch and unit tests for seq monotonicity. Will queue for expedited review. Also recommend a rolling restart after patch to clear any leftover in-memory state.
infra-john: Eviction completed across all shards. Total evicted keys ~3.2k cluster-wide. Memory per-host back to baseline (-65%).
dave.oncall: Handoff note: I'm out in 30m. Passing bridge to alice.sre. Current targets: error rate < 0.5%, memory stable, customers OK.
alice.sre: Handoff received. Monitoring dashboard up. Will keep kv.reuse disabled until patch validated canary. Scheduling short postmortem tomorrow.
carol.ml: Tests: added integration runs that failed previously now pass with seq checks. Will run extended canary with reproducer.
deploy-bot: rolling restart queued for svc-infer to pick up patch when ready. queue id roll-2149999277.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Mitigation summary: kv.reuse disabled + targeted eviction. Assigned alice.sre. Severity set to S3.
alice.sre: Thanks everyone. I'll publish a status update and owner for the postmortem (bob.runtime + carol.ml + infra-john). Monitoring window 1h then close.
infra-john: Keeping a 3h watch on eviction logs and memory. No further anomalies so far.
ale: final check after 45m: errors at baseline, customers acknowledged fix. Marking resolved in channel.
